chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"Whoever builds a mosque as small as a sandgrouse's nest, Allah will build for him a house in Paradise."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the eternal abode of reward
key_terms.قَطَاةٍ: a sandgrouse; the bird used as the comparison for a small nest
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: a mosque; a place established for worship and prostration to Allah
key_terms.مَفْحَصِ: the small hollow or nest-like spot where a bird settles; here indicating a very small size

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for building a mosque in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages believers to contribute to the building of mosques, even if their contribution seems small. It teaches that Allah greatly rewards acts that support worship and communal devotion, granting a house in Paradise in return.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.703 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Whoever builds a mosque as small as a sandgrouse’s nest, Allah (swt) will build for them a house in Paradise."
